source.title: Use of a 3x3x3 Cube with LEGO Pieces instead of stickers in Fewest Moves Solving
source.content:
Currently, in Fewest Moves Solving, the stickers can be used as indicators on a puzzle:

> [E3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#E3)) The competitor may use the following objects during the attempt. Penalty for using unauthorized objects: disqualification of the attempt (DNF).
> [E3c](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#E3c)) Stickers (self-supplied).

Other forms of indicator are allowed as long as the indicators does not break other WCA Regulations. For example, using a 3x3x3 Cube that has tiles that allow blocks (e.g. LEGO blocks) to be placed on them like stickers, is legal as long as it does not break other WCA Regulations. It is okay to use these blocks as indicating pieces by assembling instead of sticking to the puzzle surfaces. 

However, due to [Regulation E3e](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#E3e), the puzzle and the indication pieces should be approved by the WCA Delegates before being used in the Fewest Moves. The WCA Delegate should make sure the puzzles and the blocks are not illegal (e.g. contain electronic aids or might give an unfair advantage).

translation.title: 最少步中使用乐高积木替代贴纸作为标记
translation.content:
按当时规定，最少步中可以用贴纸在魔方上作标记：
> [E3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#E3) 选手可在尝试中使用以下物品；使用未授权物品的处罚为 DNF。
> [E3c](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#E3c) 贴纸，自备。

其他形式的标记，只要不违反其他 WCA 规则，也可使用。例如，三阶魔方的色片可像贴纸一样装上积木（如乐高），只要不违反其他规则便合法。通过拼装而非粘贴将积木作为标记件放在表面，是允许的。

但依据 [E3e](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#E3e)，魔方和标记件在最少步中使用前须获得代表批准。代表应确认魔方及积木不违规，例如不含电子辅助功能，也不会带来不公平优势。
